index_conventions.label_rows: One-based positions in exact accepted R24 TXT files; empty lines excluded and verified absent in these files.

index_conventions.best_proposal: Highest positive box IoU, then confidence, then original index. When all IoUs are zero, best overlapping proposal is null; a nearest retained rectangle is separately provided for orientation only.

classification_definitions.competing_assignment: At least one retained proposal meets class and IoU .50 but is assigned to another target. None of the 16 cases has this pattern.
classification_definitions.geometry_below_matching_threshold: At least one returned rectangle overlaps the target, but none reaches IoU .50. Overlap alone does not certify that a rectangle represents the same physical front.
classification_definitions.no_retained_overlap: All post-confidence/NMS retained rectangles have zero IoU with the target. The network/filter failure mechanism remains unobserved.

prior_attempt_constraints.constraint: Epoch173 already tested NMS .70/.60/.68/.50 with confidence .15/.25/.40. At .25, .60 and .50 suppressed valid partial-front matches. The .68 improvement reduced other extras, not duplicate count. It is not evidence for stronger NMS on R24.

PR35 pre-NMS trace already distinguished a confidence-gated clipped-front proposal from a tiny fragment without qualifying decoded geometry. Confidence .13 was accepted for reviewed proposals. These older model-specific mechanisms must not be imputed to R24 or blindly repeated.

PR40 five-image partial-front label extension recovered neither prespecified target; it is a completed negative result. New supervision must be materially new and supported, rather than the same extension rerun.
PR62 synthetic occlusion improved its synthetic probe but failed clean preservation, including a new empty-scene output. Do not simply rerun that recipe.

next_action: First audit visible-box supervision for comparable eligible jaw-gap and clipped-front examples, using011:55–57 as a precise geometry-versus-corner diagnostic; preserve the 3 PR35-recovered partial fronts as clean-coverage checks. Reconcile additional material eligibility/capture grouping before freezing any genuinely new training change. No new notebook, threshold sweep or promotion is implied.

These reused development frames and neighboring-looking captures do not establish unseen-session generalization.
